examples.text: Это повар Лавров Максим Леонидович.
examples.trans: This is cook Lavrov Maksim Leonidovich.

examples.text: Повара, низко кланяйтесь нашему новому су-шефу!
examples.trans: Cooks, bow low to our new sous-chef!

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'менить'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to replace', forming an aspectual pair with 'заменять'.

examples.text: Повар заменил мясо краба белой рыбой.
examples.trans: A cook replaced the crab meat with white fish.

examples.text: Заменить арест на подписку.
examples.trans: To replace arrest with a travel ban.

examples.text: Замени батарейку.
examples.trans: Replace the battery.

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'meat', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Повар заменил мясо краба белой рыбой.
examples.trans: A cook replaced the crab meat with white fish.

examples.text: А ты где мясо берёшь?
examples.trans: Where do you get your meat?

examples.text: Очень вкусное мясо!
examples.trans: Very tasty meat!

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'crab', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Завтра гость заказал свежего королевского краба.
examples.trans: Tomorrow a guest ordered a fresh royal crab.

examples.text: Проследите, чтобы завтра привезли свежего краба.
examples.trans: Make sure that they bring a fresh crab tomorrow.

examples.text: Тимур, этот краб точно настоящий королевский?
examples.trans: Timur, is this crab definitely a real royal one?

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'white', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Повар заменил мясо краба белой рыбой.
examples.trans: A cook replaced the crab meat with white fish.

examples.text: У Вики белая машина.
examples.trans: Vika has a white car.

examples.text: На белом?
examples.trans: The white one?

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'fish', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Повар заменил мясо краба белой рыбой.
examples.trans: A cook replaced the crab meat with white fish.

examples.text: Большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: A big platter of fish and crabs.

examples.text: На ужин мы приготовили свежую рыбу.
examples.trans: For dinner we cooked fresh fish.
